mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that potentiate verapamil's cardiac effects and increase risk of arrhythmias; verapamil may reduce renal perfusion and worsen amphotericin B nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor cardiac function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and renal function closely; consider alternative antifungal agents if possible; supplement electrolytes aggressively to maintain normal levels.
